nodes.label: Date-seeded deterministic SceneParams
nodes.rationale: seed = hash(YYYY-MM-DD) via cyrb128 + sfc32 so everyone sees the same scene on the same day and any date can be re-rendered.

nodes.label: Sea Sunset Favicon
nodes.rationale: 64x64 rounded-square app icon depicting a sun setting over layered ocean waves; a miniature emblem of the sea wallpaper scene

nodes.label: Turbulence Noise Texture (turbulence.png)
nodes.description: Small tileable RGB noise texture (about 128x128) with independent, blotchy multi-octave noise in each color channel. It produces saturated rainbow patches.
nodes.rationale: A packed multi-channel noise lookup lets a shader sample several decorrelated noise values (for example UV distortion offsets) in one texture fetch, so it does not have to compute procedural noise per pixel.

nodes.label: Water Turbulence / UV Distortion
nodes.rationale: The file name and look suggest it is sampled to perturb texture coordinates for water surfaces, refraction or caustics in the sea wallpaper scene.
